Education (SPbGU, law faculty, 2000) corroborated by a third, more official-leaning source (RAO ES Vostoka 2016 appendix), raising confidence in that fact. GICS sector/industry_group/industry added at company level and to every professional_experience entry, copied verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json; qualification_degree added to education/degrees entries. validation_notes: Обработано 6 человек из CSV. Проверено 2 локальных документа HYDR: годовой отчет ПАО "РусГидро" за 2024 год и консолидированная финансовая отчетность за 2024 год. Выполнено 6 research rounds, по одному на человека. Локальный годовой отчет ПАО "РусГидро" за 2024 год не раскрывает персональный состав Совета директоров/Правления в основном файле и указывает на Приложение 28, отсутствующее в локальной папке; поэтому CSV-роли "Член СД" не интерпретированы как подтвержденное членство в Совете директоров ПАО "РусГидро". Для Панина, Недотко, Евграфовой и Финкеля подтвержден контекст Совета директоров АО "РусГидро ОЦО" по отчету за 2023 год; для Исакова подтверждена связь с ПАО "РусГидро" и советами директоров дочерних/связанных обществ. Образование не найдено для Панина и Евграфовой; по Исакову и Недотко есть только слабые/частичные сведения из индексированных PDF, поэтому детализация ограничена; по Хмарину степень кандидата юридических наук оставлена с оговоркой; по Финкелю образование подтверждено. Слабые источники: индексированные, но не извлеченные полностью PDF/карточки ssc.rushydro.ru и некоторые поисковые фрагменты; они явно отмечены в notes и в отдельных полях. Остались конфликты/неопределенность по трактовке CSV-роли "Член СД" для пяти человек, поскольку публичный локальный отчет ПАО не дал персонального состава. Исключены однофамильцы: Виктор Евгеньевич Панин-физик, Виктор Евгеньевич Панин-политик, Елена Олеговна Евграфова-врач, Федор Недотко, Виктор Николаевич Хмарин, Виктор Моисеевич Финкель. Поиск считается завершенным после проверки локальных документов, официальных/корпоративных источников, источников дочерних обществ, профессиональных профилей, реестров, образования, прежних работодателей, публикаций/патентов и повторных поисковых проходов без новых надежных фактов. --- Round 2 (2026-07-19, gap-filling pass) --- Company-level sector/industry_group/industry added: Utilities / Utilities / Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers, copied verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json. Justification: the company's own 2024 annual report describes RusHydro Group as "системообразующий российский электроэнергетический холдинг и национальный лидер в сфере генерации электроэнергии на основе ВИЭ" (backbone Russian power holding and national leader in renewable-source electricity generation), i.e. a hydro/renewable generation company selling into the wholesale market rather than a vertically-integrated regulated transmission/distribution utility; this is corroborated by the already-processed DVEC ticker file, which classifies the same organization ("ПАО \"РусГидро\"") identically as an employer in a professional_experience entry. The same triple was applied to every professional_experience entry naming ПАО "РусГидро" as employer, for all six people. Other organizations were classified by their own primary business, not RusHydro's: Банк ВТБ = Financials/Banks/Banks (matches existing DATA/GAZP precedent); АО "РусГидро ОЦО" (a group shared-service center for accounting/corporate-governance methodology) = Industrials/Commercial & Professional Services/Professional Services (matches how audit/accounting/consulting firms are classified elsewhere in this dataset); ПАО "Сахалинэнерго", ПАО "РЭСК" and the newly found ПАО "Красноярскэнергосбыт" = Utilities/Utilities/Electric Utilities (regional integrated/retail electricity companies; no separate GICS bucket exists for electricity retail/sales, so Electric Utilities is the closest verbatim match, consistent with the DVEC ticker's own company-level classification for a structurally similar Far East integrated utility); ОАО "ФСК ЕЭС" = Utilities/Utilities/Electric Utilities, matching the already-processed FEES ticker file for the same company. qualification_degree added to all education/degrees entries: SPbGU 2000 (Хмарин) and both Финкель entries = Specialist degree (pre-Bologna, specialty-based graduation, high-confidence inference documented per-entry); "Кандидат юридических наук" (Хмарин) = Doctoral degree (direct mapping of the literal degree text per this project's standing convention, kept despite the degree claim itself remaining unconfirmed by any directly-read source across two rounds); the two weak "Высшее"-only entries (Исаков, Недотко) = Unknown (higher education confirmed to exist, specific tier not inferable without a graduation year). Институт normalization per university_names.json: Финкель's 2000 institution field changed from the raw "Архангельский государственный технический университет" to its canonical successor name "Северный (Арктический) федеральный университет имени М.В. Ломоносова" (both are listed in university_names.json as the same entry); no institution not already present in university_names.json was encountered, so new_institutions_found is empty for this ticker. Targeted re-research on previously flagged gaps: Хмарин's Bank VTB professional_experience entry (was null years / vague role) filled to "Советник первого заместителя председателя Правления Банка ВТБ Юрия Соловьева", 2014-2015, using the two sources already cited for this person (TAdviser, Energostrana), now fully re-read; his "Кандидат юридических наук" degree was specifically re-checked against those same sources plus a newly found РАО ЭС Востока 2016 official appendix -- none state the degree, so it is kept but flagged as still unconfirmed rather than deleted. Недотко: two previously timed-out documents (resk.ru go2016.pdf; krsk-sbit.ru board card) were successfully re-fetched and read in full this round; neither adds an education institution, but both surfaced new, well-sourced Board-membership facts (ПАО "РЭСК" 2016; ПАО "Красноярскэнергосбыт", current), added as new professional_experience entries. Исаков: the one outstanding education lead (a Sakhalinenergo PDF) was retried via two independent fetch channels and failed with a network-level connection refusal (host currently unreachable), so education remains null/Unknown. Панин and Евграфова: their respective ssc.rushydro.ru board cards were retried via two fetch methods and reconfirmed to be client-side-rendered shells with no extractable text; education stays empty for both. This session's WebSearch budget (200/200) was exhausted partway through the round, limiting further broad queries for Панин, Евграфова, and Хмарин's degree; all findable direct-URL and local-document leads were still exhausted before that point. No previously confirmed fact was deleted or silently overwritten; all changes are additive or explicitly documented replacements of previously null/vague values. DATA-LOSS REPAIR (2026-07-30): restored 4 shortened notes field(s), 4 shortened professional_experience description(s), and 0 missing source citation(s) using git HEAD (commit 03bfe9f, 2026-07-20) as the reliable baseline, after Validate found this file had regressed below that committed checkpoint. Nothing else in this file was touched. Additional repair: restored 1 person-level source citation(s) that a person-level (not per-experience) comparison against git HEAD found missing.
